description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Awoken Life], [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode (Ice, Lightning)] and [Vivi Trance] to the user

description.name: Awoken Life
description.text: Ice and Lightning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice and Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Ice, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning] after using a Ice/Lightning ability

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Vivi Trance
description.text: MAG +30%, 50% chance for Black Magic abilities to trigger 1 additional time
